clue.text: Plan, it's said, to get some liquor

indicators.note: it's said tells us a word is spoken, and what we write is a different spelling of that sound

parts.note: a plan or preliminary sketch is a draft

explanation.surface: Someone sets out a scheme to lay hands on a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A swallow or measured quantity of a drink poured out is called a draught, as in a draught of ale.

clue.text: Start to contribute in renovation of ordinary site? It's optional

indicators.note: in says the first letter goes inside the rearranged letters
a renovation remakes something, so these letters are rebuilt in a new order
Start to picks the opening letter of contribute

explanation.surface: Helping to start renovating an ordinary site is a matter of choice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'renovation of' signals the anagram of 'ordinary site'; 'in' places the first letter of 'contribute' within that anagram, after its third letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something discretionary is left to someone's judgement or choice rather than required.

clue.text: Disorientated wag in sun essentially lacking shades

indicators.note: a disorientated thing is turned about, so these letters are mixed up
essentially points at the middle of the word sun, and lacking removes it

explanation.surface: A joker, dizzy in the sunshine, has no shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sun essentially lacking' is sun without its middle letter U, so SN; 'Disorientated' rearranges WAGINSN.
explanation.definitionFit: Awnings are canvas covers stretched over windows or shopfronts to give shade from the sun.

clue.text: One with great neck overlooking Ireland makes slip

indicators.note: overlooking means missing out, so a piece is dropped from the long-necked animal

parts.note: the giraffe is the animal with an exceptionally long neck

explanation.surface: A long-necked creature peering over Ireland trips up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overlooking' looks like a tall animal peering down, but means omitting IR from GIRAFFE.
explanation.definitionFit: A gaffe is a social blunder, an embarrassing slip of the tongue or manners.

clue.text: Doctor entering course with little energy finds instrument

indicators.note: entering says the doctor goes into the name of the course

parts.note: Troon is a Scottish golf course, a regular venue for the Open Championship
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a medical degree for a doctor
E, a little bit of energy, is its abbreviation

explanation.surface: A tired doctor joining a course takes up a musical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: Troon is a links golf course on Scotland's west coast that hosts the Open.
explanation.definitionFit: A trombone is a brass instrument with a sliding tube for changing pitch.

clue.text: Spymaster with institute to remove one in the field?

parts.note: M is the head of the secret service in the James Bond stories
to doff is to take off a hat or garment

explanation.surface: A spy chief and an institute set out to get rid of somebody working in the field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the field' sounds like espionage, but it means a cricket field: mid-off is a fielding position near the bowler on the off side.
explanation.definitionFit: Mid-off is a cricket fielding position, so the fielder stationed there is one of the team in the field.

clue.text: Racket during most of supper, maybe, in ancient quarter

indicators.note: during says the noise happens within the shortened meal
most of drops the final letter

parts.note: supper is an example of a meal
a din is a loud racket

explanation.surface: Noise disturbs much of an evening meal in an old part of town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' drops the last letter of the meal word, and 'during' puts the racket inside what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: A medina is the old walled Arab section of a North African city, its historic district.

clue.text: Obscure thing used by a gymnast, an unknown quantity?

parts.note: dark means obscure or hidden
the vaulting horse is gymnastics apparatus

explanation.surface: A mysterious piece of gymnastics kit nobody can work out.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark horse is a person whose abilities are little known, a competitor of uncertain prospects.

clue.text: Dandy keeps alluring feature of a car

indicators.note: keeps says the dandy holds another word inside

parts.note: a fop is a vain man overly concerned with clothes
glam, short for glamorous, means alluring

explanation.surface: A snappy dresser holds on to the attractive look of a car.
explanation.definitionFit: A fog lamp is an extra low headlight fitted to a car for driving in poor visibility.

clue.text: Doctor faring so with director shows composure

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A doctor faring well alongside the director keeps calm under pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' reads as a medic but is the verb signalling that FARINGSO is rearranged into SANGFROI.
explanation.definitionFit: Sang-froid, borrowed from French for 'cold blood', is coolness and calm self-possession in difficulty.

clue.text: Republican showing delicacy ignoring liberal? That's correct

indicators.note: ignoring says one piece is left out of the word for delicacy

parts.note: a touch with delicacy is a light one

explanation.surface: A Republican shows finesse by overlooking a liberal, and someone approves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignoring liberal' takes L out of LIGHT, leaving IGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'right' is an exclamation of agreement, the same as saying that's correct.

clue.text: What nervous passengers might do to adopt a passive role?

definitions.meaning: an anxious passenger might literally sit in the rear seat of a vehicle
to step back and let others lead

explanation.surface: Anxious travellers retreat to the back seats, choosing to stay passive.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to withdraw from an active or leading position and let others take charge.

clue.text: Fashion includes new line of products

indicators.note: includes says the word for fashion holds another piece inside it

parts.note: the rage is the current fashion, as in 'all the rage'

explanation.surface: A fashion house brings out a fresh collection of goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A range is a set of related goods a firm sells, such as a product line of furniture.

clue.text: Something found in a park to notice as a yardstick

parts.note: a bench is a seat often found in a park
to mark something is to notice it

explanation.surface: An object spotted in a park is taken as a standard of comparison.
explanation.definitionFit: A benchmark is a standard against which others are measured, just as a yardstick is.

clue.text: Gain rest after deploying way to pacify an offender?

indicators.note: deploying sets the letters out afresh, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Police regain calm once they have used a method to subdue a suspect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after deploying' signals the rearrangement of GAINREST.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasering is firing an electric stun gun at someone, a method police use to subdue a violent offender.

clue.text: A donor hit mistakenly in US fundraising event

indicators.note: mistakenly says the letters are put in the wrong order

explanation.surface: A benefactor is wrongly struck at an American charity appeal.
explanation.definitionFit: A radiothon is an extended charity broadcast on radio, mainly an American term, raising money from listeners.

clue.text: Good old man accepts criticism for Italian spirit

indicators.note: accepts says the outer pieces take another piece into them

parts.note: pa, like old man, is an informal word for father
a rap is a sharp rebuke or criticism

explanation.surface: A decent father takes reproach over his fondness for an Italian liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: Grappa is a brandy distilled in Italy from the pressed remains of grapes after winemaking.

clue.text: Sticky situation tolerated by first of expats in lively gathering

parts.note: being in a jam is being in a tricky spot
bore is the past tense of bear, to tolerate

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of expats

explanation.surface: An awkward situation endured by the leading expat at a lively party.
explanation.definitionFit: A jamboree is a large festive gathering, from scout rallies to boisterous celebrations.

clue.text: Part of revolution's ideology considered legitimate?

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some of a revolution's doctrine might be thought lawful.
explanation.definitionFit: In football or rugby a player in a legal position is onside; more generally it means on the right side of the rules.

clue.text: Flattened spoon alas put in a different position

indicators.note: letters set in a different position are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A squashed spoon, sadly, has been moved somewhere else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put' belongs to the letters; 'in a different position' signals their rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A spatula is a flat-bladed utensil for spreading or lifting, like a broad flattened spoon.

clue.text: Traditional farewell by Northern agents in Spanish city

parts.note: vale is the Latin word for goodbye, used in a formal or old-fashioned farewell
the CIA is the American intelligence agency, staffed by agents

explanation.surface: An old-style goodbye from northern spies in a Spanish city.
explanation.definitionFit: Valencia is a large port city on Spain's east coast.

clue.text: Pretence of cleaner hoarding Ecstasy

parts.note: a char is a cleaning lady
a hoarding is a billboard displaying an advertisement, or ad
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: The cleaner pretends while stashing drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hoarding' looks like the verb 'storing', but it is the noun billboard, giving AD.
explanation.definitionFit: A charade is an absurd pretence meant to keep up an appearance.

clue.text: Those in heart of Aden see authoritarian figure

indicators.note: those in the heart of a word are its middle letters

parts.note: to spot something is to see it

explanation.surface: People in central Aden notice an autocrat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Those in heart of Aden' gives DE, the middle letters of Aden.
explanation.definitionFit: A despot is a ruler with absolute power, a tyrant.

clue.text: A lecture curtailed by old, old socialist in a weak state

indicators.note: curtailed means docked of its tail, so the word for lecture loses its last letter

parts.note: a talk is a lecture
Sidney Webb was an early Fabian socialist and founder of the London School of Economics

explanation.surface: A shortened lecture from an elderly socialist when feeling feeble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curtailed' cuts the end off TALK to give TAL. Sidney Webb (1859-1947) was a British Fabian socialist.
explanation.definitionFit: At a low ebb is an idiom from the tide having gone out, meaning in a poor or depressed condition.

clue.text: First-rate friendly chat in the Highlands?

definitions.meaning: ... as an adjective means excellent or expert, as in ... troops
in Scotland and Ireland ..., or craic, is lively conversation and banter

explanation.surface: Top-class gossip among Scots.
explanation.definitionFit: Crack works both as an adjective for elite skill and as Scottish or Irish dialect for enjoyable talk.

clue.text: Piece of garlic is left in bay

indicators.note: in says the abbreviation sits inside the word for bay

parts.note: a cove is a small bay

explanation.surface: A bit of garlic is abandoned in a bay.
explanation.definitionFit: A clove is one of the separate segments that make up a garlic bulb.

clue.text: Teenager revealed in back of country hotel

indicators.note: in says one piece sits inside the pair of letters around it
back of selects the final letter of the word country

parts.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
something revealed is out in the open

explanation.surface: A teenager is uncovered in the rear of a rural hotel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back of country' gives Y; OUT goes between it and H.
explanation.definitionFit: A youth is a young person, typically an adolescent boy between childhood and adulthood.

clue.text: Standard person that's wise to skirt working minister's residence?

parts.note: par is the standard or normal level

indicators.note: to skirt is to go around the edge, so the wise person surrounds another piece

parts.note: a sage is a wise person
a machine that is on is working

explanation.surface: A typical wise individual seems set to avoid duty at the vicar's house.
explanation.definitionFit: A parsonage is the house provided for a parish priest, a church minister's home.

clue.text: Frenchman represented agent as attractive type

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for Monsieur, a Frenchman's title

indicators.note: represented read as re-presented means the letters are presented in a new order

explanation.surface: A Frenchman acted for an agent who is charming.
explanation.definitionFit: A magnet attracts metal, and figuratively a person or place that draws others is a magnet.

clue.text: Tin, say, in part of a cooker

definitions.meaning: tin is an example of a chemical substance in the periodic table
the heating coil in an electric oven or hob

explanation.surface: A tin found in a kitchen appliance.
explanation.definitionFit: Tin is a chemical element, and the electric heating coil in a cooker is also called an element.
